explanation_method: Path contributions along the gradient-boosting trees. They sum with the model intercept to the churn log-odds for this customer. They are not SHAP values.

rules.rationale: High churn risk and high CLV proxy: place a retention call.
High churn risk with CLV below the save-call bar: offer the eligible add-on with the higher uptake propensity.
Moderate churn risk and an eligible add-on whose lookalike propensity meets the policy cutoff.
Churn risk, CLV, and offer eligibility do not match a save call or an offer.
